title: P.6 Analyzing Graphs of Functions

icans: I can use the Vertical Line Test and find the zeros of a function.
I can find where a function increases or decreases and find its average rate of change.
I can decide whether a function is even, odd, or neither.

vocab: (f(x₂) − f(x₁))/(x₂ − x₁), the slope of the __________ line

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Vertical Line Test: a graph is a function if no vertical line meets it more than _______________.
Zeros: solve f(x) = _______________; they are the x-intercepts.

blocks.stem:
Find the zeros.
a.  f(x) = 3x² + x − 10
b.  g(x) = √(10 − x²)
Use the graph of f(x) = x³ − 3x. Where is f increasing and decreasing? Find the relative extrema.

notes: Average rate of change from x₁ to x₂: _______________
Even: f(−x) = f(x), symmetric about the y-axis. Odd: f(−x) = _______________, symmetric about the origin.

blocks.stem: Find the average rate of change of f(x) = x³ − 3x from (a) x = −2 to 0 and (b) x = 0 to 1.
Find the average rate of change of f(x) = x² + 1 from x = 1 to x = 3.

tickets.stem: Is a circle the graph of a function?
Find the average rate of change of f(x) = 2x + 7 from x = 0 to x = 5.
